# Houzz

> Houzz is a comprehensive professional directory and home improvement platform connecting homeowners with local contractors, designers, and builders across all major home renovation and design categories.

Houzz serves as a marketplace for finding vetted home improvement professionals including architects, interior designers, contractors, and specialized tradespeople. The platform uses location-based matching to connect homeowners with qualified professionals in their area for projects ranging from kitchen remodels to custom home construction.

## Key Topics

- Professional Directory
- Local Contractors
- Location-Based Search
- Professional Matching
- Home Remodeling
- Interior Design
- Kitchen & Bath Design
- General Contractors
- Home Builders
- Contractor Hiring
- Home Renovation
- Design-Build Services
- Custom Cabinets
- Flooring Installation
- Architect Services
